div.span: Software for home care and clinic teams
div.p: CareJiyo helps nurses, doctors and care teams book visits, care for people at home and in the clinic, and keep families in the loop. All in one simple app.

img.alt: A nurse holds an older woman's hand while checking her blood pressure in her living room.

div.p: Made for home nursing · doctor home visits · clinics · elder care · recovery at home

div.h2: One team. Every place care happens.
div.p: Whether your nurses travel across town or your doctors see people in the clinic, everyone works from the same picture of each person’s care.

img.alt: A nurse rides a scooter through town towards a map pin.

div.p: Nurses see where to go next, get directions and tap “On my way”, so families know when to expect them.

img.alt: A nurse with a care bag waves to a family member opening the front door.

div.p: Record checks, notes and medicines during the visit. Weak signal? Keep working. It all saves when you are back online.

img.alt: A doctor in a white coat talks with a patient across a clinic desk.

div.h3: The whole story, before they sit down
div.p: Doctors see care plans, past visits and medicines in one place, including what happened at home.

div.h2: From the first call to the follow-up.
div.p: Every step is connected, so nothing falls through the gaps and nobody has to ask twice.

li.p: A family calls, sends a message or books online. Every request lands in one place.
Your coordinator picks the right nurse or doctor, by skills, availability and travel time.
The nurse taps “On my way” and the family gets a message.
Checks, notes and medicines are recorded during the visit, safely and privately.
The family gets an update, the invoice goes out and the next visit is booked.

div.span: For everyone in the circle of care
div.h2: Simple for each person. Connected for all.

ul.li: Today’s visits in order, with addresses and directions
Big, easy buttons that work with gloves and in bright sun
Keep working when the signal drops
One calendar for every nurse, doctor and clinic room
Drag a visit to move it to another time or person
See travel-time warnings before they turn into late arrivals
Know when the nurse is coming
A short, clear update after each visit
Message the care team and book the next visit

div.p: Your nurse is on the way and should arrive in about 12 minutes.
Visit finished. Mum is comfortable and her next visit is on Friday at 9:00.
Thank you so much! See you Friday.

div.h3: Run the whole service with clarity.

ul.li: Invoices and payments straight from finished visits
Insurance claims, with filing to government agencies where required and configured
Simple reports on visits, staff and income

div.p: Example screens. No real patient information is shown.

div.h2: All the tools a care team needs.

article.p: Home visits, rosters and clinic appointments on one calendar.
Care plans, visit notes and history for every person you care for.
Plan and record medicines so nothing is missed.
See people from home when a trip isn’t needed.
Messages and visit updates for the people who care most.
Invoices, payments and claims, with filing to government agencies where required and configured.
Nurses keep working on the road and catch up when they reconnect.
Health records are protected, and each person sees only what their role allows.

div.h2: Less time on screens. More time with people.
div.p: CareJiyo handles the paperwork in the background, so your team can give their full attention to the person in front of them.

ul.li: Made for home care and clinics

div.h2: Let’s talk about your care team.
div.p: Tell us how your nurses, doctors and clinics work today. We will show you how CareJiyo fits.

div.small: Pictures are illustrations. No real patient information is shown.
